new:
(\emph{nsys}) count CUPTI's page-fault groups, each of which may cover many
faults. On Stencil-24K the two counts differ by a factor of about four; on the
sparse benchmark the profiler's count is not a per-fault count at all, so we use
it only to compare thresholds on Stencil-24K.
